title: RemoteTransform2D works inconsistently with skew
body:
### Tested versions

4.3.stable.arch_linux

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable unknown - Arch Linux #1 ZEN SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 22 Feb 2025 00:38:34 +0000 - Wayland - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV RENOIR) - AMD Ryzen 5 4500U with Radeon Graphics (6 Threads)

### Issue description

RemoteTransform2D works inconsistently with skew. When update rotation is enabled skew is synchronized to the remote node. When update rotation is disabled skew is not synchronized to the remote node. I would expect skew to be either always or never synchronized, or have an option for synchronization.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a 2D scene
2. Create a Sprite2D with icon.svg
3. Create a RemoteTransform2D, set the remote path to the Sprite2D
4. Change the skew of the RemoteTransform2D, the skew of the Sprite2D will change
5. Disable update position of the RemoteTransform2D
6. Change the skew of the RemoteTransform2D, the skew of the Sprite2D will not change

The issues applies with both local and global coordinates.

I think the bug is caused by the optimization mentioned here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a9c5c4db71600328c59ae35c8dc14e0138343667/scene/2d/remote_transform_2d.cpp#L77-L78
and here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a9c5c4db71600328c59ae35c8dc14e0138343667/scene/2d/remote_transform_2d.cpp#L97-L98
RemoteTransform3D does not use this optimization.
